=== 🚀 Quick start
[b]繁體中文版：[/b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3817840347]小地圖 - MOD 地圖擴充 完整說明[/url]

The mod on Steam Workshop:
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3763914102
[h3]What you need[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Required[/b]: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3763913359]Minidoracat MiniMap[/url] (main mod) and its requirement [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3789836701]Minidoracat UI Library[/url].
[*] [b]The map mods you want to play[/b]: this pack only provides images and data, so the maps themselves must be subscribed separately.
[*] [b]Add/remove mid-save[/b]: safe either way.
[*] [b]Languages[/b]: 繁體中文, 简体中文, English, 日本語, 한국어, Русский, Español, Português, Türkçe, Français, Polski, Deutsch (please report any translation issues).
[/list]
Keep every Minidoracat MiniMap series mod up to date and restart the game after updating.
[h3]Getting started[/h3]
[olist]
[*] [b]Subscribe[/b]: the main mod and this pack.
[*] [b]Pick maps[/b]: choose map mods from the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3766382352]supported maps collection[/url], then subscribe and enable them.
[*] [b]In game[/b]: press [b]/[/b] for the minimap or [b]M[/b] for the world map; the map area shows its image, outline and name.
[/olist]
{{img:mod-map-outlines.jpg}}
=== 🧰 Supported maps (A–M)
87 map mods, 110 maps. To subscribe to them all at once, use the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3766382352]supported maps collection[/url].
[list]
[*] [b]✅[/b]: the author ships road data: street names, search and navigation work (number = street count).
[*] [b]🛠️[/b]: road data fixed or added by this pack; see "Roads fixed or added by this pack".
[*] [b]No mark[/b]: map image only, no street names, search or navigation.
[/list]

=== 🧰 Roads fixed or added by this pack
[list]
[*] [b]Constown, KY[/b]: the author ships no road data, so this pack adds 38 roads; they are searchable and routable.
[list]
[*] They are named like "Constown Rd 01 (MiniMap)".
[*] The game switches to the author's roads automatically if the author adds road data later.
[*] The vanilla Deer Trail Road stretch the map covers (the gravel road north of KY-60) follows the vanilla route with its real 5-tile width, searchable as "Constown Rd 38 (MiniMap)".
[/list]
[*] [b]Camden County[/b]: 3 author roads stopped short of junctions; they now connect, so navigation can reach them.
[*] [b]Daisy County[/b]: 44 roads drawn as outlines are converted to centre lines, so names no longer appear twice.
[*] [b]Raven Creek[/b]:
[list]
[*] The KY-79 bend where the vanilla highway enters Raven Creek had no navigation data, so routes took a long detour; this pack adds it as "Raven Creek Rd 01 (MiniMap)".
[*] Westbound routes from the east entrance no longer cut through the median trees.
[/list]
[*] [b]The Walking Dead Prison[/b]: the map covers a stretch each of the vanilla Tioga Road and Magazine Road beside the prison, and those stretches had no navigation data, so routes along Tioga Road took a long detour (about 950 tiles became about 5,300) and could not reach the prison's east gate; this pack adds both along the vanilla route, searchable as "The Walking Dead Prison Rd 01 (MiniMap)" and "The Walking Dead Prison Rd 02 (MiniMap)".
[*] [b]Muldraugh 1993[/b]: 913 street labels that exactly duplicate the vanilla map are hidden on display only; navigation is unaffected.
[/list]
=== ⚠️ Conflicts and overlaps
[list]
[*] [b]Atlanta[/b]: conflicts with Atlanta Tower Survival; choose one.
[*] [b]Foxtrot Warehouse[/b]: fully overlaps Atlanta; choose one.
[*] [b]Raven Creek[/b]: the original and its Kardinal port are either-or.
[*] [b]Willowbrook Bastion[/b]: the original and its 2026 remake are either-or.
[*] [b]Nellis Air Force Base[/b]: overlaps Blackpine County and Atlanta; choose one.
[*] [b]Mount Crow City[/b]: mostly overlaps Camden County and slightly overlaps SafeWayHamlet and AnruisiTown; choose one.
[*] [b]DuoDuo City[/b]: overlaps the edge cells of Haven Fall and Nettle Township, and one corner cell each of Tikitown and Trelai 4x4; choose one.
[*] [b]New Hartburg, KY[/b]: lies entirely inside Grapeseed and overlaps Hartburg, KY (the author lists both as conflicts); choose one. It also overlaps edge cells of Constown, Greenleaf, SecretZ Checkpoint 8 and a few others.
[*] [b]Big Bear Lake[/b]: overlaps DuoDuo City, Frogtown, Haven Fall (listed as a conflict by the author) and Macon; choose one. It also partly overlaps Fort Benning, SecretZ North Checkpoint and SecretZ Deerhead Lake Base.
[*] [b]Community Center[/b]: partly overlaps Chinatown, Chinatown Expansion, Fort JadeLake, Muldraugh 1993 and Muldraugh Fire Dept; choose one.
[*] [b]Rosewood Compound[/b]: shares one cell with Fort Preston and Taibei Road; choose one.
[*] [b]The Walking Dead Prison[/b]: partly overlaps VaultTec Road (including the north side of the prison), SecretZ Train Depot Refugee Camp and VaultTec Vault - Muldraugh; choose one.
[*] [b]Atlas Underground Complex[/b]: surface imagery only (no underground floors); it partly overlaps several nearby maps, and using them together is not guaranteed.
[/list]
=== ❓ FAQ
[h3]Do I need the original map mod?[/h3]
[list]
[*] Yes. This pack only shows a map's image while that map mod is enabled.
[/list]
[h3]Why do some maps have no street names or navigation?[/h3]
[list]
[*] Maps without ✅ have no road data from the author.
[*] Where maps overlap, covered road sections may also be missing from search (in multiplayer, the server's map order decides).
[*] Details: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3817841972]MiniMap Guide[/url]
[/list]
[h3]Can I turn off the outlines or map images?[/h3]
[list]
[*] Yes, in the minimap gear settings or the ESC mod options.
[*] The outline colour can be changed too.
[/list]
=== 💬 Feedback

[*] [b]Problems with the map itself[/b] (missing textures, buildings, conflicts): report them to the original author.
